scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend install && cd backend && uv sync
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.session:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.session:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend run preview -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
